intro: Three connected systems, scoped around the outcome your business actually needs.

items.title: Brand
items.situation: Your offer works, but its meaning and visual language are fragmented or no longer fit the business.
items.outcome: A recognisable identity system ready for consistent use across the website and core materials.
items.boundary: Trademark checks, registration, paid licences and unlimited asset production are scoped separately.

items.title: Web
items.situation: Your business needs a clear, distinctive digital presence that earns trust and guides action.
items.outcome: A responsive, accessible website with an agreed content system, technical foundation and documented QA results.
items.boundary: Ongoing promotion, ranking guarantees, unlimited migration and indefinite support are not included automatically.

items.title: Connect
items.situation: Leads and data reach the website, then disappear into manual steps and disconnected tools.
items.outcome: A documented workflow connecting the website to the agreed next business action.
includes: limited automation and AI-assisted workflows with a defined purpose
items.boundary: Each integration depends on verified API access, regional availability, third-party costs and data-protection requirements.
